stage2: experiments/v2-emergence/README.md: each digest and live count equals the V2-17 Stage-2 summary's record (stage2_summary_FINAL_104.json, kept outside git) for the same bundle, condition and seed

stills.label: Tissue, as committed
stills.caption: All 14 of the preset's mechanisms on: porous islands of tissue, several lineages side by side.
stills.command: flife render presets/morphogenesis-tissue-v2.toml --ticks 2048 --every 2048 --width 2160 --height 2160 --look glow --color lineage-energy --field-mapping energy --out FRAMES
stills.meaning: founder lineage lit by energy: the lineage's colour (lineage-energy), lighter as the organism holds more of the energy it needs to divide, black with none, white with 1.8 times it

stills.label: Every v2 feature off
stills.caption: The same preset with --v1-compat: nothing stops division in a crowd, and bodies jam into packed slabs.
stills.command: flife render presets/morphogenesis-tissue-v2.toml --ticks 2048 --every 2048 --width 2160 --height 2160 --look glow --color lineage-energy --field-mapping energy --v1-compat --out FRAMES
stills.meaning: founder lineage lit by energy: the lineage's colour (lineage-energy), lighter as the organism holds more of the energy it needs to divide, black with none, white with 1.8 times it

stills.label: Inheritance removed
stills.caption: Each newborn gets a founder's genome instead of its parent's: the population all but dies out.
stills.command: flife render CONFIG --ticks 2048 --every 2048 --width 2160 --height 2160 --look glow --color lineage-energy --field-mapping energy --out FRAMES
stills.meaning: founder lineage lit by energy: the lineage's colour (lineage-energy), lighter as the organism holds more of the energy it needs to divide, black with none, white with 1.8 times it

stills.label: Supercolony, as committed
stills.caption: All 11 of the preset's mechanisms on: compact colonies with well-fed, brightly lit rims, between blooming oases.

stills.label: Inheritance removed
stills.caption: Each newborn gets a founder's genome instead of its parent's: a few dozen organisms remain.
stills.command: flife render CONFIG --ticks 2048 --every 2048 --width 2160 --height 2160 --look glow --color lineage-energy --field-mapping energy --out FRAMES

stills.label: Polarity
stills.caption: Drawn with --color polarity and the sphere look: each cell's hue is the direction its polarity points, with a short tick on its apical side, and grey cells have none. Neighbouring cells point alike in patches.
stills.command: flife render presets/morphogenesis-tissue-v2.toml --ticks 2048 --every 2048 --width 2160 --height 2160 --look sphere --color polarity --no-field --camera CAMERA --out FRAMES
stills.meaning: apical polarity: cyclic perceptual OKLab hue wheel by apical angle, grey when unpolarized

stills.label: Cell state
stills.caption: Drawn with --color cell-state: each cell keeps its lineage's hue, and its lightness and a small twist of hue follow its first memory value h₀. At this tick h₀ varies little within a lineage, so the colours barely shift: there are no separate cell types yet.
stills.command: flife render presets/morphogenesis-tissue-v2.toml --ticks 2048 --every 2048 --width 2160 --height 2160 --look glow --color cell-state --field-mapping energy --camera CAMERA --out FRAMES
stills.meaning: cell-state: founder lineage hue darkened for h0 < 0 and lightened for h0 > 0

stills.label: Trail carrier
stills.caption: Drawn with --field-mapping trail-carrier: the uneatable second carrier, plum through amber to gold as more of it lies on the field. It halves in 23 s, so it marks where colonies passed in the last minute.
stills.command: flife render presets/supercolony-v2.toml --ticks 2048 --every 2048 --width 2160 --height 2160 --look glow --color lineage-energy --field-mapping trail-carrier --out FRAMES
stills.meaning: founder lineage lit by energy: the lineage's colour (lineage-energy), lighter as the organism holds more of the energy it needs to divide, black with none, white with 1.8 times it

stills.label: Vascular conductance
stills.caption: Drawn with --field-mapping vascular-conductance: the field's faces, bright where flux has widened them and dark seams where they have pruned back.
stills.command: flife render presets/supercolony-v2.toml --ticks 2048 --every 2048 --width 2160 --height 2160 --look glow --color lineage-energy --field-mapping vascular-conductance --out FRAMES
